text: A cinematic sci-fi digital painting of a futuristic neon city rising from golden desert sand dunes at twilight. Wide panoramic composition. Upper left: deep indigo-blue starry sky with a large glowing crescent moon, fading to warm orange sunset on the right horizon. Center-right: a cluster of sleek glass skyscrapers — a tall cyan-lit tower crowned by a bright teal glowing ring halo, flanked by a slim spire with a vertical cyan neon sign reading "OASIS" and a magenta-pink lit angular tower with purple light beams shooting upward into the sky. Tiered rounded saucer-like building bases surrounded by small low-rise skyline with tiny window lights. Foreground lower left: rolling rippled sand dunes in amber tones; a person in a long dark red cloak stands beside a light brown llama/alpaca, both seen from behind on a dune ridge looking toward the city. Right side: a giant saguaro cactus outlined in glowing pink neon, with a smaller neon cactus behind it near a small turquoise oasis pond reflecting city lights. A curved elevated monorail track with golden-yellow lighting sweeps across the lower right foreground, carrying a small white train car. Soft atmospheric haze, volumetric glow, retro-futurism meets vaporwave aesthetic, highly detailed matte painting, symmetrical central skyline, dreamy serene mood.
